_comment: morning_app: does picking each day's stocks by their first 5 minutes of volume give an edge? See the research doc 'Finding an Edge'. Rules are fixed here BEFORE a run; nothing is tuned. The data splits into development (start to development_end), validation (to validation_end) and a holdout (to end, empty = yesterday) that is only backtested with --holdout, once.
_universe_comment: Which stocks can be picked on a day, from the 14 trading days before it: price above min_price, average volume at least min_average_volume shares, 14-day ATR at least min_atr dollars. A stock needs min_history_days of first-5-minute volumes to have a relative volume.
_selection_comment: Stocks in play: each day, the `stocks` with the highest relative volume (first opening_minutes' volume against its 14-day average for the same minutes), at least min_relative_volume, and an opening bar that moved. The control is the same number of random stocks from the same universe, the same day (random_seed makes it repeatable).
_orb_comment: Opening range breakout as published (Zarattini, Barbon, Aziz 2024): opening bar up -> buy if the price goes above its high; down -> short below its low. Stop stop_atr_fraction x the 14-day ATR from the entry, sized so a stop loses risk_percent of equity, each stock at most max_leverage x equity / stocks. entry_fill next_open: a breakout is filled at the next minute's open (or the level, if worse), not at the level itself.
_costs_comment: Against us on every fill, as in every other backtest (config/screen.json). Regulatory fees on sells come from config/general.json.
_variants_comment: Every rule tried, all counted when the deflated Sharpe discounts for trying several. ORB holds to the close (15:55, config/risk.json's end_of_day). hold_minutes > 0 closes that many minutes after entry; target_r > 0 takes profit at that many times the risk. SCALP runs the live SCALP strategy with these settings (the META ones in config/strategy.json) on the in-play stocks.
_gates_comment: Pass marks from the research plan. Step 1: in-play stocks' typical 10-minute move at least min_move_to_cost x the round-trip cost. Steps 3-5: Sharpe above min_sharpe, at least min_lead_over_random ahead of the same rule on random stocks, at least min_trades trades, deflated Sharpe (the probability the true Sharpe is above zero, after counting every variant) at least min_deflated_sharpe.
